verdict.rationale: Plausible's own Stats API is a read-only HTTP interface. Its /api/v2/query endpoint accepts simple and complex queries and returns metrics as JSON, using team-scoped API keys, so an agent can programmatically pull the key metrics a dashboard needs. However, the evidence shows no API for creating or configuring dashboards inside Plausible and no MCP server, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt to aid agent use. Any end-to-end dashboard would have to be assembled outside Plausible from queried data. Missing for 10: dashboard creation/configuration API, official MCP server, machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI/llms.txt), hands-on evidence of an agent building a dashboard.
